documents.title: Customer Refund Policy v4
documents.text:
Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. The refund window starts on the delivery date, not the order date.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of approval. Store credit is available as an alternative on request.

Digital goods follow the same 30 day refund window unless the license key has been activated.

documents.title: Expense Reporting Policy
documents.text:
Submit expense reports through the finance portal within 14 days of the spend. Attach itemized receipts for every line over 25 dollars.

Per diem for travel is 60 dollars per day domestic and 90 dollars international. Alcohol is never reimbursable.

Managers approve reports up to 2000 dollars; anything larger routes to the finance director.

documents.title: Incident Response Runbook
documents.text:
On a suspected security incident, page the on-call responder and open a war room channel. Triage severity within 15 minutes.

Contain first: isolate affected hosts, rotate exposed credentials, and preserve forensic images before any remediation.

Postmortems are blameless and due within 5 business days of incident close.

documents.title: Payroll Calendar and Salary Schedule
documents.text:
Payroll runs on the 25th of each month. When the 25th falls on a weekend, salary payment moves to the preceding Friday.

Contractor invoices are paid on the 10th and the 25th. Off-cycle salary corrections require CFO sign-off.

The salary payment schedule for the December close is one week early, on the 18th.

documents.title: VPN Setup Guide
documents.text:
To set up the VPN, install the WireGuard client from the software portal, then import the profile named corp-vpn from the device management console.

Authenticate with your SSO account and approve the push notification. The VPN connects automatically on untrusted networks.

If the laptop cannot reach internal DNS after connecting, toggle the profile off and on, then contact the helpdesk.

documents.title: Internal API Authentication Reference
documents.text:
Services authenticate to the internal API with short-lived OAuth client credentials issued by the identity broker. Tokens expire after 15 minutes.

Request scopes narrowly: one scope per resource family. Wildcard scopes are rejected at the gateway.

Rotate client secrets quarterly. Static API keys are deprecated and refused since March.

documents.title: New Hire Onboarding Checklist
documents.text:
Before day one: sign the offer, complete background check, and ship the laptop to the new hire address.

Week one: account provisioning, security training, meet your onboarding buddy, and set up the development environment.

Day 30: goals review with the manager and feedback survey on the onboarding checklist itself.

documents.title: Brand Guidelines
documents.text:
The primary brand colors are deep indigo 2E2A72 and signal orange FF6B35. Use indigo for backgrounds and orange only for accents.

The logo keeps a clear space equal to the height of the wordmark x-height. Never stretch, recolor, or outline the logo.

Typography is Inter for product surfaces and Source Serif for long-form documents.

documents.title: SOC 2 Evidence Collection Process
documents.text:
SOC 2 evidence is collected quarterly: access reviews, change management samples, and backup restore proofs go into the compliance vault.

Each control owner uploads evidence within 10 days of quarter close. The compliance lead samples 10 percent for spot checks.

Auditor requests route through the compliance lead only; never send evidence directly to the auditor.

documents.title: Company Holiday Schedule 2026
documents.text:
The company observes 12 public holidays in 2026, listed on the intranet calendar. Offices close for a winter break from December 24 through January 1.

Regional holidays follow the local calendar of each office. Remote employees follow the calendar of their contracting entity.

On-call coverage during company holidays earns a day in lieu.
